scope: Dedicated translation-model candidate selection on the existing development set, followed by a separately frozen fresh validation set when available.

classification_definitions.acceptable: No material meaning error observed in the aligned case. Natural wording, contextual synonyms and valid localization can differ from the reference. This output-specific assistant judgment is not general quality approval.
classification_definitions.minor_issue: A limited wording, punctuation or precision issue is present without an established change to the central propositions or relationships.
classification_definitions.major_error: Material meaning changes, including wrong actors, role assignments, quantities, factual claims, negation, conditions or significant omissions.
classification_definitions.not_evaluable: No accepted aligned translation is available because of a structural or execution failure. Raw output alone is not a successful translation.

fresh_validation.subsequent_use: The initial frozen v2 result is preserved. Once these failures inform engineering changes, subsequent v2 runs are regression evidence and must not be described as untouched validation.

methodology: Review examines exact complete source/output pairs against their semantic criteria; references are illustrative, not mandatory wording.
Numeric localization, unit transliteration and contextual synonyms are assessed for preserved values/meaning rather than counted as errors from literal indicator flags.
This is assistant review of a small internally authored synthetic corpus. It is not independent human validation, an external benchmark, or a population accuracy estimate.
Only the old development cases inform candidate selection. The fresh validation corpus was frozen before new inference and must not be revised to fit model outputs.
The actual production adapter and observed model protocol are recorded for each run; model comparisons must distinguish protocol/configuration changes from changes to the model alone.

TranslateGemma and Hy-MT3 use distinct native prompt/protocol paths, and the recorded production-source hashes differ. This is a comparison of practical configured translation paths on the same development corpus, not a pure model-only experiment.

Qwen3.5 uses the original general JSON translation protocol, unlike the native TranslateGemma and Hy-MT3 protocols. Its comparison is a practical configured-path comparison, not a controlled model-only contrast across all three runs.

The Marian TC-big reports are direct CTranslate2 prototypes with production_integration=false. They show aligned text outputs but do not test the production adapter, fragmentation or metadata persistence; those require separate production evidence before a final adoption decision.

TranslateGemma v2 is explicitly comparison/regression evidence because initial Marian outputs had already exposed v2. Review examined all complete paragraphs; better coverage is distinguished from remaining wrong facts and object/actor relationships. V3 was frozen before corrected/comparison output inspection and remains unreviewed.

The sketch did not contain the name or address of the landowner.

Theodoros had lent his portable tripod to Iris for the inspection. She was responsible for bringing it back, but ownership had not changed. If strong wind interrupted the work, they would pack the instruments and finish the inspection another day. They did not report that strong wind had actually occurred; they were describing the procedure they would follow if it did.

The shaded probe displayed -5.4 degrees Celsius, not 54 degrees. Iris asked for the minus sign to be copied into the notes because removing it would change the meaning. A separate humidity reading was 68 percent. Neither person claimed that the temperature and humidity readings were interchangeable, and they did not infer rainfall from the humidity figure alone.

A technician had written, 'Reset the display after copying the result.' Iris read this instruction aloud but did not perform the reset. First she wanted Theodoros to verify that the reading had been recorded. The original observation would remain in the log even after the display was reset; a blank display was not evidence that no measurement had been taken.

The final check concerned probe RZ-58. Its public dashboard could show the aggregated readings, but the landowner had not consented to publication of the exact site coordinates. The next inspection was scheduled for Saturday at 10:15. Iris would return the tripod to Theodoros then, and the canvas carrying bag would stay inside the locked shelter until that visit.
